Deferred tax on statutory reserve had not been taken into account in the financials for 31 December 2018 and as at 31 December
2017. As a result, the error resulted in an understatement of deferred tax liability and overstatement of the statutory reserve
Tax impact of omitting the Additional Unexpired Risk Reserve (AURR)

The Insurance Regulatory Authority requires introduced a requirement that an Additional Unexpired Risk Reserve be made on
loss making underwriting classes of business. Profit from discontinued operations from prior year was overstated as a result of
computational error on the required reserve.
